verdict.rationale: incident.io Investigations starts automatically when an incident is declared. It gathers change events, recent code changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents, then forms and tests hypotheses against code and telemetry, with an adversarial agent pressure-testing findings. This covers the proactive probable-cause story as written. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the investigations perform as documented.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an AI investigator digs into the probable cause — correlating changes, telemetry, and similar past incidents — before a human even asks

citations.quote: The moment an incident is declared, an investigation gathers context from across your stack: the alert and its stack trace, similar past incidents, incident channel discussion and change events, your runbooks, recent code changes, and your telemetry.
It's a structured process that gathers evidence, forms a hypothesis, then tests that hypothesis against your code and telemetry, refining its conclusion as new evidence arrives.
Investigations automatically work out what's going on during an incident, doing the legwork a responder normally would, faster and across every source at once.
pressure-tests every hypothesis with an adversarial agent before it reaches you
